title: Brown split factorizations for cofibrant and fibrant objects
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a category [def-nagata-category] with all small limits and colimits and three classes of maps $C,F,W$. Assume $W$ has two-out-of-three, all three classes are closed under retracts, and $(C,F\cap W)$ and $(C\cap W,F)$ are weak factorization systems: each map factors into the indicated left and right classes, and each class is precisely the maps with the corresponding left or right lifting property. Write $0$ and $*$ for initial and terminal objects. An object $X$ is cofibrant if $0\to X$ belongs to $C$, and fibrant if $X\to *$ belongs to $F$.

For every $f:X\to Y$ with $X,Y$ cofibrant there are $Z$, $i:X\to Z$ in $C$, $p:Z\to Y$ in $F\cap W$, and $s:Y\to Z$ in $C$, such that $p i=f$ and $p s=1_Y$. Dually, for every $f:X\to Y$ with $X,Y$ fibrant there are $Z$, $i:X\to Z$ in $C\cap W$, $p:Z\to Y$ in $F$, and $r:Z\to X$ in $F$, such that $p i=f$ and $r i=1_X$.
